ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 1 Nov 2026
points: Your site answers shipping, but 0 of 30 ads mention it, so buyers wondering if it arrives alive get no reason to click. Open three new ads with the shipping answer: how each plant is packed and when it arrives.

None of your 30 ads carries a proof number, so buyers comparing plant shops have nothing concrete before the click. Collect one real figure, like your review count or orders shipped, and open three ads with it on the creative.
17 of 30 ads are catalog feed ads with no story, so a cold buyer sees a grid and no reason to stop. Add three story ads that follow one beginner plant from unboxing to its first week at home.

Your 13 copy ads open in 8 different ways, so no story repeats enough to build recognition. Keep the two you already run most, cut the other six openings, and make the next batch of six ads from those two.
